title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
prompt: An array of unique integers, sorted in ascending order, is rotated at an unknown pivot. Given the rotated array `nums` and a `target`, return its index, or -1 if not present. Your algorithm must run in O(log n) time.
constraints: All values of nums are unique.
hints: At each step of binary search, at least one half of the array (split at mid) is properly sorted — figure out which.
If the left half is sorted and target falls within its range, search there; otherwise search the right half (and vice versa).
This is still a single O(log n) binary search, just with an extra check per iteration to decide which half to keep.
